headline: Copper Fund Rises as Southern Copper Gains in Wobbly Market
summary: The CPER copper fund rose 0.97% to US$39.37 as oil slumped, while Southern Copper gained 1.03% in a wobbly market.
why: Copper and related exchange-traded funds serve as barometers for industrial demand and global economic health, closely watched by mining and materials investors.
